Pace,Ⓒs.ⒹpadaM, caraRanyAsaH, padavikzepaH-pAtaH-kramaH, pAdavikzepaH-nyAsaH, vikramaH.
Ⓑ
 2 gati f., gamanaM, ayanaM, calanaM, cAraH.
Ⓑ
 3 gativegaH-kramaH; ‘a quick p(ace)’ drutapadaM; ‘at a rapid p(ace)’ drutagatyA.
Ⓑ
 4 (Of horses) DArA, gatiH; See under Horse; ‘a horse with a good p(ace)’ suKAyanaH, suKacAraH; ‘keep p(ace) with’ saha gam or cal 1 P.
Ⓔv. i.Ⓓpari-ati-kram 1 U, 4 P; krameRa krameRa gam-vraj-cal 1 P; ‘p(ace) up and down’ itastataH cal or Bram 1, 4 P; ‘p(ac)ing to and fro’ itastataH parikramya.
Ⓝ[Pac]ed,Ⓒa.Ⓓgati in comp.; ‘slow-p(aced)’ maMdagati, maMdagAmin.

Pacify,Ⓒv. t.ⒹsAM(SAM)tv 10, Sam c. (Samayati), pra-upa-°, pra-sad c., saM-pari-tuz c., ArAD c.
Ⓝ[Pacif]ied,Ⓒa.ⒹSAMta, prasAdita, SAMtakroDa; ‘to be p(acified)’ Sam 4 P, prasad 1 P, tuz 4 P, SamaM i-yA 2 P.
Ⓝ[Pacif]ier,Ⓒs.ⒹSamakaH, sAMtvakaH.
Ⓝ[Pacif]ic,Ⓒa.ⒹSAMta, praSamita, nirudvega.
Ⓑ
 2 sAMtva-praSama-SIla; sAMtvanakArin, sAma in comp.; ‘p(acific) words’ sAmavAdaH.
Ⓝ[Pacif]ication,Ⓒs.ⒹSamaH, SamanaM, SAMti f., pra-upa-°, sAMtvanaM, sAman n., prasAdanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 saMDAnaM, saMDikaraRaM.
Ⓝ[Pacif]icatory,Ⓒa.ⒹSAMtida, SAMtikara (rI f.), Samaka, sAmopA-yaka, sAma in comp.

Pack,Ⓒs.ⒹBAraH, kUrcaH, BAMqaM, gucCaH, powalikA, pawalaM.
Ⓑ
 2 gaRaH, saMGaH, vargaH, samUhaH, vfMdaM, saMcayaH; See Multitude; ‘p(ack) of hounds’ SvagaRaH, kukkurasaMGaH; ‘a p(ack) of persons’ maMqalaM, janasamUhaH; ‘p(ack)-horse’ pfzWyaH, sTOrin; ‘p(ack)-saddle’ paryARaM, palyAnaM; ‘p(ack)-thread’ SaRasUtraM; ‘p(ack)-cloth’ vezwanaM, pawaH.
Ⓔv. t.ⒹpawalIkf 8 U, puwIkf, puwayati (D.), sapiMq 10, kUrcIkf; ‘p(ack) in a box’ samudgake ni-DA 3 U or niviS c.
Ⓑ
 2 kukarmArTaM-upa daMSapUrvaM-saMmil c. or samAhf 1 P or ekIkf or saMyuj 7 U, 10.
Ⓑ
 3 (Off) apa-niH-sf c., sahasA apagam c. (gamayati) or prasTA c. (sTApayati).
Ⓔv. i.ⒹpuwIBU 1 P, piMqIBU, ekIBU.
Ⓑ
 2 sahasA apagam 1 P or prasTA 1 A.
Ⓝ[Pack]age,Ⓒs.ⒹBAMqaM, kUrcaH, vastrAdigucCaH.
ⓃPacket,Ⓒs.ⒹpowalikA, laGukUrcaH, laGuvezwanaM; patravezwanaM.
Ⓑ
 2 patravAhinI nOH.
